ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Shariah religion intellect life property dignity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Shariah religion intellect life property dignity has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Shariah religion intellect life property dignity.
   D. Use Shariah religion intellect life property dignity to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Qadar? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Qadar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Say Selected Chapter Surah al- Hujurat has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Tawbah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawbah has no place in daily life.

   C. Use Tawbah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawbah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Tawbah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
